correctness.rationale: Nonzero fixed-domain equations force gh to be a maximal-subgroup idempotent; resulting domains are exactly the corresponding H-class with zero. The normalized multiplication produces all and only inner conjugations G/Z(G) between every ordered pair of nonzero idempotent H-classes. Their domains intersect only in zero, giving exactly the Brandt product, and a separate global identity appears precisely when m>1. Finite independently constructed partial maps verified eleven patterns and all their compositions; computations support but are not the general proof.
